summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by MAAP, launched 6 January 2026 in the 'Aurora' purple look with a flame motif. Jayco fills the chest, with AlUla (Arabic script over ALULA) under it; the back carries both title sponsors — the layout differs between the race jersey worn in the launch riding photos (AlUla large across the upper back, a smaller Jayco down the side) and MAAP's replica jersey product photos (Jayco large across the upper back, AlUla large down the left of the back). AlUla is also across the seat and down the back of the legs of the bib shorts. GIANT is on the upper chest and down both sleeves, CADEX is on the upper chest, the sleeves and both legs of the bibs, three stacked MAAP marks sit on the upper chest with smaller MAAP marks on the back and stacked marks on the hips of the bibs, and letsgo sits at the collar and on the lower back. Marked complete: the club's launch photos and MAAP's product photos of the jersey and bib (front, back and both sides) show no other sponsor, and no Jayco mark on the bib shorts (a Jayco bib-leg entry in an earlier revision was removed on review as unsupported). 'GreenEDGE Cycling' is the team's own wordmark, the UCI WorldTeam badge is an award and '#ExperienceAlUla' is AlUla's hashtag; none has a sponsor record. Giant also supplies the team's bikes and MAAP makes the kit.
